summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs, with a Note on the coordinate format; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset rewritten to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with a length check that raises the exact NotImplementedError message, and ceiling-division worker partitioning; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed); monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter); docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry); tests/test_grid_dataset.py (new, TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). No tests were run and nothing was committed. Pinned test values were checked for consistency by reasoning only, not execution. Remaining lines over 120 characters in get_valid_patch_size predate this change and were left alone.
